quotes.excerpt: Our help center is pretty big, and customers weren’t finding half of what was already there. Now they just ask the question normally and get the relevant answer. Support still handles the harder stuff, but we get far fewer tickets asking for information that was already sitting in our docs.
quotes.attribution: Jonathan Reed | VP, Customer Success | Stacklane

quotes.excerpt: We get a lot of questions from people who are interested but not ready to talk to sales yet. StepsAI handles that part really well. By the time someone books with us, they’ve usually already checked pricing, integrations, and whether we can support their use case.
